title: Verified Recovery and Rollback Engine — Overview and definition
body: Public edition. Public tool knowledge, fact-checked reference. PROPOSED CAPABILITY TARGET. This record describes a proposed future-grade capability target from the source paste. It is a specification of what such a tool would do, NOT a claim that it has been implemented, tested, or proven. A tool specification alone does not make an otherwise impossible technology achievable. Some entries build on existing research; others would require major scientific breakthroughs, new hardware, or extensive engineering. Restores a known-good state and checks that recovery succeeded. A proposed engine for the worst day: when something goes wrong, it restores a known-good state — and then verifies that the recovery actually succeeded, rather than assuming it. Every recovery is tested, logged, and reviewed, so "we rolled back" means "we confirmed we are good."
